reviewer: Codex static review (model-assisted; not an independent human review)

criteria.rationale: The trigger distinguishes approved behavior changes from unknown-defect diagnosis and final acceptance verification.
Inputs explicitly require approved scope, expected behavior, diagnosis findings, test framework, and risk context.
Nine ordered steps define baseline inspection, failing tests, smallest implementation, risk-based depth, and handoff.
The output contract requires approved behavior, tests, test-first evidence, implementation paths, execution record, exceptions, and residual risk.
The skill has explicit authorization boundaries, stop conditions, and honest reporting of unavailable tests/baselines.
Three direct cases cover debugging handoff, test-first implementation, and final verification; formal near-miss/edge labels are not recorded.

gaps: Add formal coverage labels and a near-miss/edge case for unavailable harness or unrelated baseline failure.
summary: Static document review only. This score does not establish behavioral performance; runtime remains NOT_RUN.
